from your wifey

A little reminder.

Hi, Lablab. 🤍 Wala namang special occasion today. I just wanted to make something for you and remind you how thankful I am that I have you. Thank you for being part of my days — sa masasayang moments, sa random kwentuhan, sa kulit, sa tampuhan, and even sa mga araw na hindi everything feels easy. I may not always say it perfectly, pero I hope you always know how deeply I love you. I know life and love won't always be highs. May days na pagod tayo, may misunderstandings, may moments na kailangan natin ng extra patience and understanding. Pero through all of those, I hope we keep choosing each other. Not only when everything feels light and easy, but especially when things get hard. I want to keep growing with you, supporting you, celebrating your wins, comforting you on your low days, and making more memories with you. I don't need us to be perfect. I just want us to keep being honest, gentle, patient, and willing to find our way back to each other every time. I'm so grateful for you, Lablab. And no matter how ordinary the day is, loving you will always be something worth celebrating. I love you so, so much. Always, Your Wifey 🤍
